meta.rule: Only values read on an official page this session are shown. Room rates, resort fees, taxes, parking and cancellation terms that were not verified are left blank (null) and flagged. meta.true_cost_formula: true nightly cost = nightly rate + mandatory resort fee + tax (calculator uses rate + resort fee + 13.38% — the 13.38% tax rate is user-provided and unverified: Flagged F9)
meta.ranking_rule: Cost/quality first, reasonable walking distance second: the ≤30-minute walk filter applies to labeled estimates; within the filtered set, sort by true nightly cost (once a rate is captured in the rate log).
